title: Finite presentation is closed under kernels, images, and cokernels over a coherent ring
statement: Let R be a commutative ring such that every finitely generated ideal of R is finitely presented. If f:M\to N is an R-linear map between finitely presented R-modules [def-sc-finitely-presented-module], then \operatorname{Ker}(f), \operatorname{Im}(f), and \operatorname{Coker}(f) are finitely presented R-modules [def-sc-finitely-presented-module].
